# CANDIDATE: CLOSING_WICK_REVERSAL_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
A pronounced upper wick on a bearish candle near resistance, accompanied by waning volume and overbought RSI, signals imminent reversal to the downside. This setup aims to capture short-term reversals in ranging/choppy markets by entering short at the close of such a candle.

## Mechanism
Entry: When price is within 0.3% of a named resistance level (prior day high, swing high, or VWAP‑1SD) and forms a bearish candle (close < open) with upper wick length ≥ 2 * body length AND volume < 0.7 * average volume of the last 5 bars AND RSI(14) > 60, enter short at close of that candle.  
Exit: Stop above the high of the candle (or above the resistance level); target at the nearest support (prior day low or VWAP) or use 1.5R with runner trailing 12% off HWM.
